verification_requirements: All 279 operation contracts remain present and discoverable for authenticated MCP principals.
Default call path cannot select session, shared-link, maintenance or another user's key.
Runtime-context metadata is not reused as an independent feature permission list.
Each session-only, shared-link-only and API-key-only service condition preserves upstream status/body.
Public/setup and maintenance variants explicitly document absence of API-key scope checks.
Special adapters are tested with isolated credentials without using real family accounts.
Session owner validation requires no extra user.read scope on the registered API key.
Generic headers/query cannot override authentication precedence.
Maintenance Set-Cookie and other secret-bearing response fields remain principal-bound and model-inaccessible by default.
Specification must not claim API-key-only full-success coverage or invisible session scope inheritance.
